blurb: Guests can do tandem skydiving with an experienced instructor for their first jump. The facility offers Accelerated Freefall (AFF) training to learn to skydive solo and progress toward a license. Experienced skydivers can use turbine aircraft, rigging services, coaching, and participate in events year-round.

quotes.text: This place truly is such a welcoming place for 1st timers to the pros! I recommend coming to Skydive Deland over anywhere else. They make you feel so safe and service. My instructor was so great with letting me know exactly what was going to happen.

Such a great experience for first time jumpers!!! The staff was super knowledgeable and made everyone feel at ease. We did get the video to capture these first-timers, and it's definitely worth it to catch all the action in the air! Will be back!
Best school in the US, guys are skilled, knowledgeble and very cool. The whole setup is like in a movie.
